@param (TSDoc).description:
Document a parameter. TSDoc takes no type in braces — the type comes from the TypeScript signature.
https://tsdoc.org/pages/tags/param/

@returns (TSDoc).description:
Document the return value. TSDoc uses `@returns`; there is no `@return`.
https://tsdoc.org/pages/tags/returns/

@typeParam (TSDoc).description:
Document a generic type parameter. The name is bare — no braces.
https://tsdoc.org/pages/tags/typeparam/

@remarks (TSDoc).description:
The detailed part of a doc comment; everything before it is the summary.
https://tsdoc.org/pages/tags/remarks/

@alpha (TSDoc).description:
Modifier tag. Early preview — may change without notice.
TSDoc standard tag.
https://tsdoc.org/pages/tags/alpha/

@beta (TSDoc).description:
Modifier tag. Preview — not yet stable.
TSDoc standard tag.
https://tsdoc.org/pages/tags/beta/

@public (TSDoc).description:
Modifier tag. Part of the supported public API.
TSDoc standard tag.
https://tsdoc.org/pages/tags/public/

@internal (TSDoc).description:
Modifier tag. Not part of the public API.
TSDoc standard tag.
https://tsdoc.org/pages/tags/internal/

@experimental (TSDoc).description:
Modifier tag. Same meaning as `@beta`.
TSDoc standard tag.
https://tsdoc.org/pages/tags/experimental/

@eventProperty (TSDoc).description:
Modifier tag. The property returns an event object others can subscribe to.
TSDoc standard tag.
https://tsdoc.org/pages/tags/eventproperty/

@override (TSDoc).description:
Modifier tag. Overrides a member from the base class.
TSDoc standard tag.
https://tsdoc.org/pages/tags/override/

@sealed (TSDoc).description:
Modifier tag. Must not be extended or overridden.
TSDoc standard tag.
https://tsdoc.org/pages/tags/sealed/

@virtual (TSDoc).description:
Modifier tag. May be overridden by a subclass.
TSDoc standard tag.
https://tsdoc.org/pages/tags/virtual/

@readonly (TSDoc).description:
Modifier tag. Treat as read-only regardless of the signature.
TSDoc standard tag.
https://tsdoc.org/pages/tags/readonly/
